SELECT year, sum(try_cast(total_amount_reimbursed AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_health.medicaid_sdud WHERE state = 'XX' AND try_cast(year AS integer) BETWEEN 2015 AND 2024 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which states are home to the most benefit plan sponsors filing Form 5500?
SELECT spons_dfe_state, count(DISTINCT spons_dfe_ein) AS sponsors FROM govblock_nonprofits.dol_f_5500 WHERE spons_dfe_state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many PubChem compounds share caffeine's formula, C8H10N4O2?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_mass WHERE c1 = 'C8H10N4O2'
What kinds of notices does SAM.gov carry most often: solicitations, awards or presolicitations?
SELECT type, count(*) AS notices FROM govblock_awards.sam_opportunities GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of trademark applications are filed before the mark is in use, on an intent-to-use basis?
SELECT round(100.0 * count_if(cast(lb_itu_file_in AS varchar) = '1') / count(*), 1) AS pct_intent_to_use FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_case_file
Which industries have the most companies registered with the SEC?
SELECT sicdescription AS industry, count(*) AS companies FROM govblock_sec.submissions_companies WHERE sicdescription <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much coal did power plants in Kentucky receive in 2020?
Eia923 Eia Schedules M Final Revision Page Fuel Receipts And Costs

SELECT sum(try_cast(quantity AS double)) AS tons FROM govblock_energy.eia923_eia_schedules_m_final_revision_sheet_page_fuel_receipts_and_costs WHERE plant_state = 'KY' AND fuel_group = 'Coal' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2020'
What kinds of intervention do clinical trials test most often?
SELECT type, count(DISTINCT nct_id) AS trials FROM govblock_health.ct_interventions WHERE type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the SMILES string for ibuprofen?
SELECT c1 AS smiles FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_smiles WHERE c0 = '3672'
Which states had the most single audits submitted for 2023?
SELECT auditee_state, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_executive.fac_general WHERE audit_year = '2023' AND auditee_state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the total of final penalties assessed in hazardous waste enforcement actions?
SELECT sum(try_cast(fmp_amount AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_environment.echo_rcra_enforcements
Which kinds of public debt cost the most in interest in fiscal 2024?

SELECT expense_type_desc, sum(try_cast(month_expense_amt AS double)) AS interest FROM govblock_treasury.interest_expense WHERE record_date BETWEEN '2023-10-01' AND '2024-09-30' AND expense_catg_desc LIKE '%PUBLIC%' AND expense_type_desc IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of registered committees lean Democratic, Republican or neither?
SELECT cmte_pty_affiliation, count(DISTINCT cmte_id) AS committees FROM govblock_fec.committees GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which states recorded the most births in 2024?
SELECT stname, try_cast(births2024 AS double) AS births FROM govblock_census.popest_co_est_alldata WHERE cast(sumlev AS varchar) = '40' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
What is the average severity score of a designated primary care shortage area?
Bcd Hpsa Fct Det Producer Prices
SELECT avg(try_cast(hpsa_score AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_health.hrsa_bcd_hpsa_fct_det_pc WHERE hpsa_status = 'Designated'
Which vehicle powertrains does the Annual Technology Baseline model most variants of?
SELECT vehicle_powertrain, count(DISTINCT vehicle_detail) AS vehicle_types FROM govblock_energy.oedi_atb_vehicles WHERE vehicle_powertrain IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many hours a week did private-sector employees work on average in December 2024?
SELECT value AS weekly_hours FROM govblock_labor.bls_ce_data WHERE series_id = 'CES0500000002' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND period = 'M12'
Which universities received the most NIH funding in fiscal year 2024?
SELECT org_name, sum(try_cast(total_cost AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE cast(fy AS varchar) = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the median home value in Westchester County, New York?
SELECT value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 WHERE geo_id = '0500000US36119' AND variable = 'B25077_E001'
Under which statutes are patent cases most often brought?
SELECT case_cause, count(*) AS cases FROM govblock_patents.litig_cases GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much marketable Treasury debt was outstanding at the end of 2024, in millions?
SELECT max(try_cast(total_mil_amt AS double)) AS marketable_millions FROM govblock_treasury.mspd_table_1 WHERE record_date = '2024-12-31' AND security_type_desc = 'Total Marketable'
Which parent companies won the most in federal contracts over the last 12 months?
SELECT recipient_name, try_cast(last_12_contracts AS double) AS contracts FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_recipient_profile WHERE recipient_level = 'P' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many filings in the notes data set came from companies in New York State?
SELECT count(*) AS filings FROM govblock_sec.sec_fsnds_sub WHERE stprba = 'NY'
Which age groups suffered the most traffic deaths in 2022?

SELECT CASE WHEN a < 16 THEN 'under 16' WHEN a < 25 THEN '16 to 24' WHEN a < 35 THEN '25 to 34' WHEN a < 45 THEN '35 to 44' WHEN a < 55 THEN '45 to 54' WHEN a < 65 THEN '55 to 64' WHEN a < 75 THEN '65 to 74' ELSE '75 and over' END AS age_group, count(*) AS killed FROM (SELECT try_cast(age AS integer) AS a FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_person WHERE inj_sev = '4' AND cast(death_yr AS varchar) = '2022') WHERE a < 998 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Treasury bill auctions were held in 2024?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_treasury.auctions_query WHERE security_type = 'Bill' AND substr(auction_date, 1, 4) = '2024'
Which hospitals received the most Medicare inpatient payments in 2021?
Medicare Inpatient Hospitals By Provider And Service

SELECT rndrng_prvdr_org_name AS hospital, rndrng_prvdr_state_abrvtn AS state, round(sum(try_cast(tot_dschrgs AS double) * try_cast(avg_mdcr_pymt_amt AS double))) AS medicare_paid FROM govblock_health.medicare_inpatient_hospitals_by_provider_and_service WHERE source_file LIKE '%DY21%' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How did debt held by the public change from January 2, 2020 to January 2, 2025?
SELECT record_date, try_cast(debt_held_public_amt AS double) AS held_by_public FROM govblock_treasury.debt_to_penny WHERE record_date IN ('2020-01-02', '2025-01-02') ORDER BY 1
Which parent companies enroll the most Medicare Advantage members?
Ma Enrollment By Contract Plan State County

SELECT parent_organization, sum(try_cast(enrollment AS double)) AS enrollees FROM govblock_health.ma_enrollment_by_contract_plan_state_county WHERE parent_organization IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of hazardous waste inspections find a violation?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN found_violation = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_environment.echo_rcra_evaluations
Which cities have the largest Asian citizen voting-age population?
SELECT geoname, try_cast(cvap_est AS double) AS citizens_18_plus FROM govblock_elections.cvap_place WHERE lntitle = 'Asian Alone' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
In how many counties does the map show at least one substation?
SELECT count(DISTINCT countyfips) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_electric_substations
Which states received the most campaign spending in 2020?
SELECT state, sum(try_cast(transaction_amt AS double)) AS spent FROM govblock_fec.operating_expenditures WHERE cast(rpt_yr AS varchar) = '2020' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of e-filed nonprofit returns are full 990s, 990-EZs and private foundation 990-PFs?
SELECT return_type, count(*) AS filings FROM govblock_nonprofits.irs_990_index GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which top-level enzyme classes catalyse the most Rhea reactions?

SELECT CASE substr(id, 1, 1) WHEN '1' THEN 'Oxidoreductases' WHEN '2' THEN 'Transferases' WHEN '3' THEN 'Hydrolases' WHEN '4' THEN 'Lyases' WHEN '5' THEN 'Isomerases' WHEN '6' THEN 'Ligases' WHEN '7' THEN 'Translocases' END AS enzyme_class, count(DISTINCT rhea_id) AS reactions FROM govblock_chemistry.rhea_rhea2ec GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many PubChem compounds have aspirin as their parent compound?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_parent WHERE c1 = '2244'
What are the largest single awards the National Science Foundation has ever made?
SELECT name, awardtitle, try_cast(awardamount AS double) AS dollars FROM govblock_grants.nsf_awards ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
What do elementary school teachers earn at the 90th percentile nationally?
SELECT occ_title, a_pct90, a_median FROM govblock_labor.oes_all_data_m_sheet_a WHERE area_title = 'U.S.' AND occ_title LIKE 'Elementary School Teachers%' AND naics_title = 'Cross-industry' LIMIT 5
Which organisations have received the most patent assignments?
SELECT ee_name, count(*) AS assignments FROM govblock_patents.assign_assignee WHERE ee_name <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
